newsitem.title: USA: Leo Burnett buys stake in medical ad agency.
newsitem.headline: Leo Burnett buys stake in medical ad agency.

text.p: Leo Burnett Co Inc said Tuesday it acquired an interest in Williams-Labadie Advertising, an independent medical advertising agency based in Itasca, Ill. Terms were not disclosed.
"According to leading indicators, healthcare will be the biggest sector of the economy in the year 2000," said James Jenness, vice chairman and chief operating officer of Leo Burnett.
Williams-Labadie, founded in 1990, posted billings of $28 million in 1996.

While continuing to operate independently, both companies will collaborate on new business opportunities and offer the expanded capabilities of the new partnership to clients interested in reaching both the consumer and the medical professional.
Leo Burnett had billings of more than $5.65 billion in 1996.
